-- ok/c_bridge.lgo --
package main

/*
#include <stddef.h>

struct item {
	int id;
	struct item *next;
};

static struct item the_item = {7, 0};

static int c_add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

static struct item *c_find(int id) {
	if (id == 7) {
		return &the_item;
	}
	return NULL;
}

static struct item *c_next(struct item *n) {
	if (n->next != 0) {
		return n->next;
	}
	return n;
}
*/
import "C"

// Add calls C and returns a Go int.
func Add(a, b int) int {
	return int(C.c_add(C.int(a), C.int(b)))
}

// Find returns the item with the given id. C returns NULL for a missing
// id, and the result is a pointer in a non-nil result.
func Find(id int) *C.struct_item {
	return C.c_find(C.int(id))
}

// Stored keeps the C result in a declared non-nil variable and reads it.
func Stored(id int) int {
	var it *C.struct_item = C.c_find(C.int(id))
	return int(it.id)
}

// ID reads the id of an item.
func ID(it *C.struct_item) int {
	return int(it.id)
}

// Next returns the item after n, or n itself at the tail.
func Next(n *C.struct_item) *C.struct_item {
	return C.c_next(n)
}

// ZeroItem declares a C item value; pointer fields of C structs stay
// nilable under Go semantics.
func ZeroItem() C.struct_item {
	var n C.struct_item
	return n
}

// ArgStore passes a C result directly as an argument.
func ArgStore(id int) int {
	return int(ID(C.c_find(C.int(id))))
}

// Holder carries a non-nil pointer field.
type Holder struct {
	It *C.struct_item
}

// FieldStore stores a C result into a struct field.
func FieldStore(id int) int {
	h := &Holder{It: C.c_find(C.int(7))}
	h.It = C.c_find(C.int(id))
	return int(h.It.id)
}

// LitStore stores a C result in a literal field element.
func LitStore(id int) int {
	h := &Holder{It: C.c_find(C.int(id))}
	return int(h.It.id)
}

// SliceStore stores a C result into a slice element.
func SliceStore(id int) int {
	s := make([]*C.struct_item, 0, 1)
	s = append(s, C.c_find(C.int(7)))
	s[0] = C.c_find(C.int(id))
	return int(s[0].id)
}

// IsNil compares a C result with nil.
func IsNil(id int) bool {
	return C.c_find(C.int(id)) == nil
}

-- ok/app.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
)

type Num struct {
	N int
}

type Str struct {
	S string
}

// Value is a closed union of Num and Str.
type Value interface {
	Num | Str
	Describe() string
}

func (n Num) Describe() string {
	return "num:" + strconv.Itoa(n.N)
}

func (s Str) Describe() string {
	return "str:" + s.S
}

func pick(n int) Value {
	if n > 0 {
		return Num{N: n}
	}
	return Str{S: "none"}
}

// total adds two numbers through the C bridge; ? returns the parse error.
func total(a, b string) (int, error) {
	x := strconv.Atoi(a)?
	y := strconv.Atoi(b)?
	return Add(x, y), nil
}

func tryFind(id int) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return "id:" + strconv.Itoa(ID(Find(id)))
}

func tryStored(id int) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return "id:" + strconv.Itoa(Stored(id))
}

func tryArg(id int) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return "id:" + strconv.Itoa(ArgStore(id))
}

func tryField(id int) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return "id:" + strconv.Itoa(FieldStore(id))
}

func tryLit(id int) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return "id:" + strconv.Itoa(LitStore(id))
}

func trySlice(id int) (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return "id:" + strconv.Itoa(SliceStore(id))
}

func main() {
	sum, err := total("40", "2")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("sum:", sum)
	_, err = total("x", "2")
	fmt.Println("bad:", err != nil)
	fmt.Println(pick(sum).Describe())
	fmt.Println(pick(0).Describe())
	fmt.Println("find:", tryFind(7))
	fmt.Println("stored:", tryStored(7))
	fmt.Println("find-missing:", tryFind(9))
	fmt.Println("stored-missing:", tryStored(9))
	fmt.Println("arg:", tryArg(7))
	fmt.Println("field:", tryField(7))
	fmt.Println("lit:", tryLit(7))
	fmt.Println("slice:", trySlice(7))
	fmt.Println("isnil-missing:", IsNil(9))
	fmt.Println("isnil-present:", IsNil(7))
	fmt.Println("arg-missing:", tryArg(9))
	fmt.Println("field-missing:", tryField(9))
	fmt.Println("lit-missing:", tryLit(9))
	fmt.Println("slice-missing:", trySlice(9))
	fmt.Println("next:", int(Next(Find(7)).id))
	fmt.Println("item:", int(ZeroItem().id))
}

-- badtry/c_bridge.lgo --
package main

/*
int c_one(void) { return 1; }
*/
import "C"

import "strconv"

// parse uses ?, which a file that imports "C" cannot.
func parse(s string) (int, error) {
	// A comment with ? and $"x" is fine.
	n := strconv.Atoi(s)?
	return n + int(C.c_one()), nil
}

func main() {}

-- badlambda/c_bridge.lgo --
package main

/*
int c_one(void) { return 1; }
*/
import "C"

func main() {
	inc := x => x + int(C.c_one())
	_ = inc
}

-- okbridge/c_bridge.lgo --
package main

/*
#include <stddef.h>
static int *c_null(void) { return 0; }
*/
import "C"

func main() {
	var p *C.int = C.c_null()
	println(int(*p))
}

-- goerr/c_bridge.lgo --
package main

/*
int c_one(void) { return 1; }
*/
import "C"

func broken( {
	_ = C.c_one()
	_ = "what? $\"x\" a => b"
}

const limit = 8

const (
	first = iota
	second
)

type Plain struct {
	A int `json:"a"`
	B []byte
}

type Shape interface {
	Area() int
}

func fine() int {
	const local = 3
	switch limit {
	case 8:
		const inCase = 1
		return local + inCase
	}
	return first + second
}
